products.name: Deepgram
products.note: Speech recognition API; real-time transcription; model customization; on-prem option

profile_text.body:
Deepgram is a voice AI company that offers enterprise-focused APIs for speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice agent functionality. The company describes itself as "the industry's voice AI leader" and positions its platform around unifying those three capabilities, along with LLM orchestration, into a single API intended to reduce complexity, latency, and cost for businesses building voice-driven applications.

The company's flagship product is the Deepgram API, which supports real-time transcription, model customization, and on-premises deployment. Deepgram has also introduced Flux TTS, which it describes as "the first voice model that thinks before it speaks," designed to maintain tone, expression, and continuity across a conversation. The site notes that Flux TTS is available to build with for free through September 12th, with up to 45 concurrent streaming connections in the US and 5 in the EU and AU. Deepgram also lists an integration with Amazon Connect among its offerings.

The site's held facts confirm Deepgram has a tracked presence on theworldofai.org, with its core product categorized under Voice and Audio. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are currently held for the company.
